title: Restriction of τ(M,θ,ξ) to a Borel set A is τ(M∩A,θ,ξ)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ D_n(U), and let (M, θ, ξ) be a rectifiable triple in U (IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ) with T(ω) = τ(M,θ,ξ)(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω,ξ⟩ dHⁿ (tauAction n M θ ξ ω) for all ω ∈ Dⁿ(U). If A ⊆ ℝ^P and S ∈ D_n(U) satisfy IsRestriction T A S, then S(ω) = ∫_{M∩A} θ⟨ω,ξ⟩ dHⁿ = tauAction n (M ∩ A) θ ξ ω for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsRestriction T A S → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = tauAction n (M ∩ A) θ ξ ω
